EC1: - Living donor transplant [OR] or change to peritoneal dialysis planned
EC2: - Physical assessments contraindicated for the following clinical reasons
EC3: - Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) within the last 3 months (chest pain, [OR] ECG changes [OR] or typical biomarker elevation).
EC4: - Any current uncontrolled cardiac dysrhythmias causing symptoms (chest pain, [OR] palpitations, [OR] syncope [OR] or dizziness)
EC6: - New York Heart Association grade IV Heart failure
EC8: - Acute pulmonary embolus [OR] or pulmonary infarction in the last 3 months
EC11: - Acute systemic infection, [AND] accompanied by fever, [OR] body aches [OR] or swollen lymph glands
EC13: - Life expectancy of less than twelve months
